faq: Do I need technical knowledge to use the plan?

No. The plan is written in everyday language, with each idea explained by what it does for a customer or your team. Technical notes sit at the end for a developer, so you can pass them on if you hire one.
Will you tell me if AI is not worth it for me?
Yes. If an idea costs more than it saves, or depends on data you do not have, we say so and mark it as skip. A short honest list is more useful than a long hopeful one.
What do you need from me?

A few minutes on the order form, plus view access to the tools you use, such as your store, helpdesk or spreadsheets. We never ask for passwords. You add us as a collaborator or share exports instead.
Can you build the features afterwards?
Yes, if you want. The plan ends with a suggested first feature, and the other services on this page cover building it. There is no obligation, and the plan is yours to hand to anyone.
